title: Vibrant Flaky Ukrainian Fish Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring fresh fish and flaky pastry, perfect for a festive meal. This pescatarian-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a tandoor oven.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, cold butter, and a pinch of salt, then use a pastry blender to work the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add the chopped onion, dill, and a pinch of black pepper to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Add the beaten egg to the bowl and mix until the dough comes together in a ball.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of cod fish in the center of each circle, then fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Place the dumplings in the preheated tandoor oven and cook for 20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional chopped dill if desired.
